title: Frozen SWAP 4.3.1 Fixed-Weir Secondary Balance Source Inventory

fixed_target.modern_classification: derived physical control target for the active interval; no continuation memory required

equations: if WLSTARA > zbotdr(1+nrpri)+1e-4 then SWSTTARA=SWSTLEV(WLSTARA), WSMAX=WSCAP else SWSTTARA=0, WSMAX=0
target_storages.modern_classification: derived trial targets; WSCAP is capacity, not an accepted mass flux

branches: 0 <= SWSTMAX < SWSTTARA: maximum supply is implicitly assumed and storage becomes SWSTMAX
first_projection.modern_disposition: dry-floor semantics are governed by D3 and may not create or destroy water; actual q_supply must be explicit

branches: SWSTMAX <= SWSTTARA: storage forced to SWSTTARA, implying exactly the supply needed to reach the supply target
SWSTTARA < SWSTMAX <= SWSTTAR: no supply and no discharge; storage equals the no-supply projection
second_projection_without_supply.modern_disposition: materialize actual supply as a first-class result and preserve the exact storage mass equation

fixed_weir_discharge_branch.entry: SWMAN=1 after the no-supply projection exceeds SWSTTAR
fixed_weir_discharge_branch.top_capacity_check: SWSTN = SWST + (QDRD + QRapDra - Q(top))*DT + RUNOTS; if SWSTN > S(top), legacy raises overflow
fixed_weir_discharge_branch.implicit_balance: find h between HBWEIR and +100 cm such that S(h) approximately equals SWST + (QDRD + QRapDra - Q(h))*DT + RUNOTS
fixed_weir_discharge_branch.risk: SWSTN is mass-consistent with WDISI but need not equal SWSTLEV(WLSI) at the stopping point; storage and level can therefore become mutually inconsistent

SWQHR1_reader.consistency: HBWEIR may not lie below the deepest secondary channel bottom; when SWMAN=1 and supply capacity is nonzero, HBWEIR-WLDIP must remain above the secondary bottom plus the source threshold

SWQHR2_exclusion.observation: for table discharge, HBWEIR is assigned at the first table entry with Q<1e-4 while the table is only required to reach Q<1e-6; the nominal crest can therefore correspond to small but nonzero tabulated discharge
SWQHR2_exclusion.disposition: SWQHR=2 is excluded from D4 and requires a separate source/equation disposition

storage_relation.semantics: 22-knot piecewise-linear level-to-storage and inverse relation qualified only for stable interior use by D1

numerical_history_outside_physical_balan.disposition: numerical policy/runtime diagnostics; not additional fixed-weir physical state
